documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: During the financial year ended March 31, 2026, Khaitan (India) Limited achieved a significant revenue growth of about 45% to Rs. 112.23 Crores, driven largely by its electrical goods business segment. However, profitability saw a slight decline due to increased operational costs amid global geopolitical tensions. The company suspended its sugar division operations owing to huge working capital requirements and input costs, while its agriculture division maintained small revenues. Management remains focused on expanding its electrical goods market share, improving operational efficiencies, and sustaining profitability.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for the electrical division's products is increasing due to quality and brand value.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for the product is increasing due to quality and brand value.

demand_outlook.claim: The company notes that the market for electrical goods is increasing substantially due to continued demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Further. Company is also increasing the product mix to grab larger share of electrical goods market, which is increasing substantially due to continued demand.

margins_costs.claim: The operating profit margin expanded due to cost optimization, better sales mix, and efficiency in operations.
margins_costs.quote: Expansion in margins due to cost optimization, better sales mix, and efficiency in operations.

capital_allocation.claim: The company decided to withhold dividend for the financial year to conserve resources, improve liquidity, and fund expansion activities.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve resources, your directors have decided to withhold the dividend during the financial year.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors decided to withhold the dividend during the financial year to conserve resources, improve liquidity, and cater to expansion funds.
capital_allocation.quote: With a view to conserve resources, your directors have decided to withhold the dividend during the financial year. This will conserve the resources and improve liquidity and cater to the fund for the expansion activity of the Company.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operation of the sugar division was suspended because of huge working capital requirements and very high input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operation of the Sugar Division has been suspended owing to factor of the huge working capital requirement and very huge input cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: The operation of the sugar division has been suspended owing to factors including huge working capital requirements and very high input costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The operation of the Sugar Division has been suspended owing to factor of the huge working capital requirement and very huge input cost, Company believes that it may expect some turnaround in future.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to have access to more markets through various online market platforms for the marketing of its electrical products.
management_commitments.quote: Also, the Company is planning to have access to more markets through various online market platforms for the marketing of its product.

management_commitments.claim: The management states that as soon as the requirement of working capital needed for running the operations is arranged, sugar mill operations shall be resumed.
management_commitments.quote: The management is of the view that as soon as the requirement of working capital needed for running the operations is arranged the operation shall be resumed.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
